collection.title: Mazda 6 Estate 2016 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mazda 6 Estate 2016 - 2018 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and an 18" on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also have the rear blade for this Mazda 6, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
